integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof and standalone exact-rational checker; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact norms only for canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut/cycle projections of unweighted fan graphs. Fibonacci resistance kernels were known; novelty centers on absolute-current extremizers and parity-swapped endpoint norms. Equivalent prior norm calculations cannot be excluded by bibliographic search. The exact-rational program tests finite cases and does not constitute a proof for all parameters.
title: Fibonacci–Lucas parity law for fan-graph Hodge projection norms
